findings.title: Direct internal SQL can bypass the manager contract
attack_path: A future in-process component receives the shared SQLite connection.
It writes current project tables without ProjectStateManager.
Revision, lifecycle, validation, or event invariants are bypassed.
evidence: The service exposes the manager as the intended owner.
SQLite constraints bound shapes but do not encode every controller transition.
findings.recommendation: Do not add direct writers; add database transition triggers if ownership expands.

findings.title: Project prose is untrusted content for future model consumers
attack_path: An operator or importer stores instruction-like text in an objective or item detail.
A future model adapter concatenates the text as instructions.
The model expands authority or performs an unauthorized action.
evidence: The implemented subsystem does not call a model, tool, shell, or network service.
findings.recommendation: Keep project text in delimited untrusted-data channels and enforce capabilities outside model output.

findings.title: Pattern-based secret scanning cannot prove absence of every credential
attack_path: A credential format is not recognized by the scanner.
The value is supplied as project text or an evidence reference.
The credential persists in SQLite and may appear in a snapshot.
evidence: All operator text and evidence references pass the shared high-confidence secret scanner.
No finite pattern scanner establishes universal secret absence.
findings.recommendation: Keep credentials out of project state and store only opaque secret references through the secret manager.

findings.title: Dependency traversal is bounded by project and edge limits
attack_path: A caller submits a large or cyclic dependency graph.
An unbounded implementation consumes excessive resources.
evidence: Projects are capped at 512 items and each item at 32 dependencies.
Closed JSON files are capped by the shared CLI loader and cycles are rejected before commit.
findings.recommendation: Preserve these limits and benchmark before increasing them.

limitations: The review does not assess a future issue-tracker importer, model summarizer, or remote synchronization service.
Actor hashes provide content minimization, not cryptographic authentication.
SQLite file access remains governed by host filesystem permissions.
